title: Lead intake and edit UI
objective: Full-page New Lead / Edit Lead form implementing PRD 9.3/12.6 exactly: three titled sections on a two-column grid, party picker with inline creation, dependent cover types, tenant-currency inputs, duplicate dialog, UI-standards validation (spec FR-29..FR-32).
scope: Section 1 Party: searchable party dropdown with + New party inline expansion / read-only summary collapse
Section 2 Request Details: date received, channel, conditional broker, owner default, region, conditional external ref
Section 3 Coverage Need: product line -> cover type dependency, currency inputs, policy term with Other companion, derived priority, intake notes
Duplicate warning dialog with Create anyway / Review existing
Validation behavior: inline on blur+submit, summary banner at >=3 errors, unsaved-changes prompt, sticky footer
implementation_details: features/leads/LeadFormPage.tsx composed of PartySection.tsx (type-ahead over partiesApi; selecting shows read-only summary card of type/segment/industry/region and collapses new-party fields; '+ New party' expands inline fields reusing party form field components from T-025; ?partyId= renders the section locked), RequestSection.tsx (dateReceived DatePicker default today max today; channel dropdown; broker SearchSelect visible-required only when selected channel isBrokerChannel; owner SearchSelect from eligible-assignees endpoint default current user when eligible; region dropdown defaulting from selected party's region; externalRef input rendered only when tenant manual_external_ref_enabled, warning-on-duplicate non-blocking), CoverageSection.tsx (productLine change resets coverType; coverType disabled until productLine; CurrencyInput component with tenant currency symbol prefix + thousand separators; policyTerm select 6/12(default)/24/36/Other with companion text input appearing and required only when Other (Q-11); priority select Normal/High initialized from derived value (estimatedPremium > threshold) and user-overridable with 'derived' hint; intakeNotes textarea spanning both columns)

Submission: POST /leads; on requiresConfirmation warning envelope -> DuplicateLeadDialog listing duplicates with links, buttons Review existing (navigates) / Create anyway (resubmits with createAnyway:true); on success navigate to /leads/{id} with toast 'Lead {ref} created'
Edit mode: same form pre-populated, lifecycle/outcome fields never present (FR-30); Save changes label; closed-lead edit surface follows availableOperations/permissions
Form engine: react-hook-form with zod schema mirroring (not duplicating beyond UX needs) backend rules; FormErrorSummary component when >=3 field errors; server fieldErrors mapped back to fields

e2e: lead-intake.spec.ts: create lead with existing party (summary collapse verified); create lead with inline new party; broker becomes required when broker channel chosen; cover type resets on product line change; policy term Other reveals required companion; premium above threshold derives High priority (overridable); duplicate dialog appears for same party+product within window, Create anyway proceeds; 3+ errors show summary banner; unsaved-changes prompt on nav; success lands on Lead Detail with toast
